narrative: On the part. A part on a bench in the tiring-parlour. The play's afternoon is at two. Where a name would be written, the paper is blank. On the part. The same blank at the head. No character's name added. No speech written on the paper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the roll unnamed and went on with the afternoon.

entities.name: Titus Andronicus
entities.context: Shown on part in No name on the roll
